note: Literature confirms FDXR variants cause post-synaptic auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder, and studies are actively evaluating cochlear implant stimulation strategies for post-synaptic cases.

evidence.text: FDXR variants are documented as an etiology of post-synaptic auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder with pronounced cochlear nerve atrophy, yet patients can show marked improvement in speech scores after cochlear implantation.

source.title: Cochlear nerve atrophy in postlingual ANSD: diagnostic clue and implications for cochlear implantation
source.quote: Novel variant of FDXR as a molecular etiology of postlingual post-synaptic auditory neuropathy ... Postsynaptic post-ANSD showed significantly greater CN atrophy than presynaptic cases and sSNHL. Although CN atrophy was pronounced, it did not predict poor CI outcomes within the observed thresholds. Speech scores improved markedly post-CI, with no correlation to CN size.

evidence.text: Mutations in mitochondrial genes including FDXR contribute to post-synaptic auditory neuropathy, in which neural response telemetry ECAP and functional gains show distinct profiles under tailored stimulation parameters compared to presynaptic cases.

source.title: Effects of electrical stimulation rate in genetically confirmed pre-and post-Synaptic auditory neuropathy in children
source.quote: Mutations in FDXR and BCAP31 reduce ATP and mitochondrial potential, heightening … for cochlear implant programming. ... Postsynaptic cases showed limited ECAP responses and smaller functional gains. ... Findings support individualized CI programming guided by genetic and neural profiles.
